title: Amazon Delivery Coordinator
why_it_fits: Content Specialist match. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview: Headquarters: Colorado, USA URL: http://thinkvinculum.com Vinculum is a U.S.-based Amazon agency hiring an Amazon Delivery Manager to keep our Marketing, Seller Operations, and Creative teams executing on time and on standard. If you have or had hands-on experience in Amazon advertising or seller operations, then you're a fit. If you love building systems that make teams run better, we'd love to have you apply for this role. A few things to know up front: This is an internal project coordination role , not a client-facing one This is not a hands-on-keyboard PPC or seller ops role. You won't be running campaigns or fixing listings yourself. What you will do is coordinate the people who do, and that * requires * being conversational in core Amazon concepts so you can follow the work and keep it moving. Concepts you should be comfortable with, for example: ACoS, TACoS, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands A+ Content, Brand Registry, Brand Store Buy Box, listing health, account health, Seller Central What you'll own: ClickUp as the source of truth across all delivery teams Internal meetings, agendas, and follow-through Holding team members accountable to commitments, including senior staff Converting Looms into structured SOPs Driving cross-functional projects from scope to completion Read the full job description and application instructions here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/15rNk34qzR7KgKkIecc50FrlHh9q2PkRB/view?usp=sharing IMPORTANT: To be considered, you must complete the application form linked in the full job description. Applications submitted without a completed form will not be reviewed. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vinculum-services-amazon-delivery-coordinator
